tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250bla 'gugs kyi sngags bzla ba ni/1$0000300 rang nyid yi dam du gsal ba'i ngang nas/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer lcags kyu'i rnam pa can dpag tu med pa 'phros/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma dang bcas pa'i thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul/ slar yang 'od zer sna tshogs steng 'og phyogs mtshams kun tu 'phros pas/ sa 'og sa steng sa bla'i khams thams cad khyab/ bla tshe la bar du gcod pa'i steng gdon gza' dang rgyu skar/ 'og gdon sa bdag klu gnyan/ bar gdon btsan dang rgyal po la sogs mdor na gdon bgegs kyi rigs su gyur pas brkus pa dang*/ phrogs pa dang*/ bzhams pa dang*/ yar pa dang*/ 'khyams pa dang*/ stor ba la sogs bkug /yon gyi bdag por bstims pas/ nyams pa gsos/ chad pa mthud/ yo ba bsrangs/ sngar bas kyang gzi brjid dang ldan nas bla tshe srog gsum mi nor zas gsum la sogs pa rgyas shing brtan par gyur/

spro bsdu'i dmigs pa gsal ba dang*/ a ha ri ni sa rdzab rdzab rdzub rdzub bha dra slong slong nṛ khug dza dzaḥ brgya stong khri 'bum sogs dang*/ rtags sbyar te bzla 'o// thun drug gam bzhi bcad pa'i cho ga bzlas pa dang bcas pa bya/ dngos sam rmi lam gyi ltas dang bstun pa'i skabs/ rgyal po'i pho brang ngam kun dga' ra ba dang*/ chos ra chen po 'am grong khyer chen po'i mdo khrom 'dus ra lha srin 'dus ra/ mi ming lo khams 'di zhes pa'i bla tshe nyams pa dang yar pa/ stor ba dang phros pa/ 'khyams pa dang phrogs pa/ brkus pa dang bkug pa thams cad rang gnas su khug cig / ces skad gsang mthon pos 'bod cing bstim pa'i mos pa brtan por byed/ skabs mtshams su yon bdag gam bla rten gang rung gi mdun du kha gtad la bla lug chu dang bcas pa bzhag /dmod bor kha bskor la/ yon bdag gi bla rten phyogs su kha bstan nas 'dug na khug pa'i rtags yin pas bzang*/ bkra shis par shog// /
